# This is Suricata version 8.0.8 RELEASE, run by make-ssh-verdicts.py; do not edit by hand.
# 'rule SID RULE', or 'refused SID RULE' when Suricata does not load it,
# then 'packet NS HEX SIDS': the packet's time in nanoseconds, its IP
# bytes and the sids that alerted on it, a sid once per alert, '-' for none,
# then 'end N SIDS': what alerted when flow N was flushed at the end of
# the capture, its last address byte being N, then 'proto N NAME': the
# application protocol Suricata logged for flow N.
rule 14000 alert ssh any any -> any any (msg:"ssh 14000"; ssh.software; content:"OpenSSH_";)
rule 14001 alert ssh any any -> any any (msg:"ssh 14001"; flow:to_client; ssh.software; content:"OpenSSH_8";)
rule 14002 alert ssh any any -> any any (msg:"ssh 14002"; flow:to_server; ssh.software; content:"PuTTY";)
rule 14003 alert ssh any any -> any any (msg:"ssh 14003"; ssh.proto; content:"2.0";)
rule 14004 alert ssh any any -> any any (msg:"ssh 14004"; ssh_proto; content:"PUTTY";)
rule 14005 alert ssh any any -> any any (msg:"ssh 14005"; ssh.software; content:"SSH-2.0-";)
rule 14006 alert ssh any any -> any any (msg:"ssh 14006"; ssh.software; content:"Ubuntu";)
rule 14007 alert ssh any any -> any any (msg:"ssh 14007"; ssh.software; content:"OpenSSH_8.9p1"; isdataat:!1,relative;)
rule 14008 alert tcp any any -> any any (msg:"ssh 14008"; ssh.software; content:"OpenSSH";)
rule 14009 alert ssh any any -> any any (msg:"ssh 14009"; ssh.proto; content:"1.99";)
rule 14010 alert ssh any any -> any any (msg:"ssh 14010"; ssh.software; content:"Erlang/"; pcre:"/^5\x2e1\x2e[0-4]/R";)
rule 14011 alert ssh any any -> any any (msg:"ssh 14011"; flow:to_server; ssh_proto; content:"2.0";)
rule 14012 alert ssh any any -> any any (msg:"ssh 14012"; flow:to_client; ssh.software; content:"ConfD-";)
rule 14013 alert ssh any any -> any any (msg:"ssh 14013"; ssh.software; content:"OpenSSH_9.0"; isdataat:!1,relative;)
refused 14014 alert ssh any any -> any any (msg:"ssh 14014"; ssh.software; content:"\r";)
rule 14015 alert ssh any any -> any any (msg:"ssh 14015"; ssh.proto; content:"2.0"; isdataat:!1,relative;)
